title: A differing output forces a query
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates with query alphabet $Ω$ and output labels $α$, and let $x,y:Fin(n)toΩ$ agree at every coordinate other than $i$. If $T$ returns different outputs on $x$ and $y$, then the query trace of $T$ on $x$ contains $i$.

x and y are inputs in Ωⁿ
